title: AI_ORCHESTRA Project State
description: Model static and current project configuration needed by the orchestrator.

default_branch.description: The default development branch, e.g. main.

protected_branches.description: List of branches protected from direct pushes or modifications.

source_root.description: Absolute filesystem path to the AI_ORCHESTRA source root.

runtime_worktree_root.description: Absolute filesystem path to the root directory where run worktrees are created.

runtime_runs_root.description: Absolute filesystem path to the root directory where temporary run data is stored.

current_phase.description: The current phase of the project, e.g., Phase 0.
